Workbook generation failed to populate expected data cells, resulting in 'None' values across multiple matrix blocks.
The test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats failed with multiple AssertionErrors. Specifically, cells in ranges H12:L17 and H35:L40 returned None instead of expected float values (e.g., H12: expected 612.5, got None). This indicates the logic in task_sheet(wb) failed to correctly write or calculate values in the 'Task' worksheet. Ensure the workbook generation logic targets the correct cell references and handles data insertion properly.
